summary: Iter-24: tested two new VIP features — (1) client-side 'Running late' heads-up and (2) Taxi line in the Cancel preview. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_running_late_and_cancel.py 9/9 PASS: POST /vip/schedule/bookings/{id}/late works for BOTH sides — VIP token sets booking.late and emits vs_late notification to the admin requester ('Your VIP is running N min late'); admin token sets booking.client_late and emits vs_late notification to the VIP ('Your client is running N min late'). Third-party (freshly-registered user) -> 403. Invalid minutes (7) -> 400 BAD_MINUTES. Window rule verified: non-confirmed -> 400 NOT_DATE_TIME; start>+3h ahead -> 400 NOT_DATE_TIME. Cancel refund math with taxi coins (coins=300, taxi_coins=100): client cancels -> refunded=200 (date 100 + taxi 100), compensation=50, platform_fee=50 — matches cancel-preview math exactly. VIP cancels with same booking -> refunded=300 (full incl taxi), comp=0, fee=0. Without taxi (coins=200, taxi=0) client cancel -> refunded=100, comp=50, fee=50. UI Playwright on /vip-bookings as admin/client in the My Requests tab for a confirmed booking inside the 3h window with taxi_coins=100: vs-late-{id} 'Running late' present, panel text 'Let your VIP know how late you\'ll be' (client copy), clicking 10' toasts 'Your VIP has been notified' and renders vs-client-late-badge-{id} '⏱ Client running 10 min late'. Cancel preview dialog rows observed: cancel-preview-paid 🪙300 · cancel-preview-taxi '🚕 Taxi refunded in full' 🪙100 · cancel-preview-date-back 'Date coins back (50%)' 🪙100 · cancel-preview-refund 'You get back' 🪙200 · cancel-preview-comp 🪙50 · cancel-preview-fee 🪙50 — all data-testids present, all values match the backend split and the spec. No console errors.
action_items: Legacy /app/backend/tests/test_pickup_arrived.py is still broken from iter-23 (hits removed /pickup/propose + /pickup/decline). Delete it — new coverage lives in test_pickup_offer_flow.py.
critical_code_review_comments: vs_cancel refund math: fee = base - refund - comp is computed on the non-taxi base (correct), but the server returns {refunded, compensation, platform_fee} without the breakdown of taxi vs date — frontend has to re-derive 'date back' as refund - taxi. Minor API ergonomics flag; works correctly as-is.

RunningLateButton.send catches error and shows e.response?.data?.detail — pydantic 422 'minutes: value is not a valid integer' would render the raw object. BAD_MINUTES/NOT_DATE_TIME strings are handled, but any new validation error would surface awkwardly. Non-blocking.

CancelPreviewDialog.cancelSplit uses Math.round which can disagree with backend's Python round() (banker's rounding) on .5 edges — e.g. base=100 -> round(50)=50 both; base=90 -> round(45) differs (45 vs 45 — ok). For coins divisible by 2 current test values this is fine; worth noting if non-even taxi/coins amounts ever ship.
